correctness.rationale: All vertices have even degree and every two distinct vertices share exactly one neighbor, so A²=I+J and AJ=JA=0 over GF2. Since |F_m| odd, J²=J, A³=A, B²=J, AB²=0. Because A,B commute, their word normal forms are exactly seven. Leaf-pair sum coordinates show ranks B=m+[m even], AB=m-[m odd]; A,A² rank 2m; all distinct m>=2, including parity boundary. Fixed A points count 2^(m+[m odd]), A² fixed 2^(2m) giving primitive two-cycles, and B²=J gives the two uniform fixed points. Random stopping requires first A and second B, yielding stated disjoint survival law and mean. Independent full GF2 basis/exhaustive states m=2..6 support but unbounded m proven by matrix identities.

value.rationale: An exact switching semigroup, minimal uniform reset word and exact random-reset tail are natural finite-field dynamics and fault-tolerant synchronization invariants, in a canonical non-complete-multipartite graph family. It is a structural classification for every m rather than an arbitrary small instance.

final_claim: For friendship graph of m>=2 triangles with common hub, open XOR adjacency A and closed XOR adjacency B=I+A on GF(2)^(2m+1) generate seven distinct transformations I,A,A²,B,AB,J,0. Reset iff a word contains >=1 A and >=2 B; exact ranks, periodic orbit counts, zeta functions and random-switching uniform-annihilation time law E[T]=2/theta+theta²/(1-theta) follow.
limitations: All updates synchronous, GF2, zero affine term, m>=2; only uniform-annihilation first prefix distributed.
